Type.evidence_source: [/page/2/Text/6] The interviews ranged between 33 and 114 min in duration, and a total of 292 photographs and accompanying captions [/page/2/Text/7] were provided by the participants. The interviews were transcribed verbatim, anonymized, and checked for accuracy.

Area.evidence_source: [/page/2/Text/8] A multi-stage thematic analysis approach (Braun & Clark, 2006) was used to identify GB2SM's perspectives on suicidality within a nexus of constraints and opportunities for optimal mental health. First, the interview transcripts were imported to Nvivotm 11.0, and the frst two authors read all the transcripts multiple times to get familiar with the data, writing memos to note initial interpretations and trends, and to create a provisional codebook. Then, the frst author performed an initial round of coding. At this stage, descriptive labels and codes were further developed to organize data segments, and the analyses of data allocated to each code were reviewed to inductively derive key themes. The initial codes included gender, negative early experiences, migration, homophobia, employment, poverty, social isolation, culture, violence, and health care.
